about.title: About Athiaa Foundation
about.subtitle: Nurturing street angels with dignity, medical care, and lifelong protection.
about.missionDesc: To eliminate animal suffering across India through emergency rescue, comprehensive medical care, humane population management, and community education.
about.visionDesc: A society where every street dog lives free from cruelty, pain, and neglect, valued as a sentient companion.
about.storyDesc: Founded in New Delhi, Athiaa started as a small group of street feeders and has grown into a tech-enabled animal rescue organization.
about.value1Desc: Every animal receives individual care and dignity.
about.value3Desc: Long-term ABC (Animal Birth Control) & rabies eradication.

rescue.immediateStepsTitle: What to do while waiting for rescue:
rescue.step1: Keep safe distance and avoid alarming the frightened animal.
rescue.step2: Provide shade or dry cover if animal is in harsh weather.
rescue.step3: Offer fresh water, but do not force food if severely traumatized.
rescue.step4: Stay at location or leave a landmark marker for the rescue vehicle driver.
